SELECT s.store_id, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_keys, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_ids,
 min(f.sale_date) mind, max(f.sale_date) maxd, sum(CASE WHEN w.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_order,
 count(DISTINCT w.status) AS nstat, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS minload, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS maxload
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-30'
GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.quantity AS units
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.sku, cur.product_name, cur.category, cur.subcategory, round(sum(n.net_sales),2) AS web_net_sales, sum(n.units) AS units, min(business_date) mn, max(business_date) mx
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_product cur ON cur.sku=n.sku AND cur.is_current
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT business_date, sum(net_sales) AS v FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT business_date, net_sales AS c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04')
SELECT (SELECT sum(v) FROM mine) AS mine_total, (SELECT sum(c) FROM ctl) AS ctl_total,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM mine) AS mine_days, (SELECT count(*) FROM ctl) AS ctl_days,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c USING(business_date) WHERE abs(coalesce(m.v,0)-coalesce(c.c,0))>0.01) AS days_diff,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY sku HAVING count(*)>1)) AS multi_current_skus,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status='processing') AS processing_orders,
 (SELECT max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) FROM fact_web_order) AS max_dispatch

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales) DESC) AS rank, n.sku, cur.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_product cur ON cur.sku = n.sku AND cur.is_current
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY n.sku, cur.product_name
ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
